input.old_string:
# Focused geometry check: P boundary is the discrete convex outline
# (leftmost/rightmost per y-row, plus full topmost and bottommost rows).
# Gate on EXISTS so incomplete Docker contexts (no tests/) still configure.
set(CHECK_BOUNDARY_LR_SRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/check_boundary_lr.cpp")
if(EXISTS "${CHECK_BOUNDARY_LR_SRC}")
  add_executable(check_boundary_lr
    "${CHECK_BOUNDARY_LR_SRC}"
  )
  target_include_directories(check_boundary_lr PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(check_boundary_lr
    CGAL::CGAL
  )
endif()

# Baseline binaries used by the web compare pane and benchmark.py.
input.new_string: # Baseline binaries used by the web compare pane and benchmark.py.

input.command: rmdir tests 2>/dev/null; git status && git diff && git log -5 --oneline

fix: remove check_boundary_lr so Docker builds without tests/

The focused geometry test binary is unused by the viewer and deploy; dropping
it (and its CMake target) fixes Cloud Run by not requiring tests/ in the
Docker context.
EOF
)" && git status && git push -u origin HEAD

npx -y gh-axi pr edit 20 --title "fix: remove check_boundary_lr for Cloud Run Docker builds" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- Cloud Run Deploy failed after #17/#18 because `CMakeLists.txt` always built `check_boundary_lr`, while the Dockerfile builder stage never `COPY`s `tests/`.
- Removed `tests/check_boundary_lr.cpp` and all CMake references to that binary (no EXISTS gate). The focused geometry check is not needed for the viewer or deploy; dropping it fixes Cloud Run by no longer requiring `tests/` in the Docker context.

## Test plan
- [x] Repo grep shows no leftover `check_boundary_lr` mentions.
- [ ] After merge, Deploy on push to main rebuilds Cloud Run successfully.
EOF
)"
